pr_body:
This is by no means the final product, but is a stepping stone towards where we want to be. It also completes the "stable parity" requirement at least.

"Why is this not a customisable HUD component?"

Because the implementation changes based on context (multiplayer vs solo currently, but may also support playlists at a later point), it makes it hard to add position flexibility. Especially since in multiplayer we want it to always display.

For now it makes more sense to get the flow in place, then figure out how to allow customisation of positioning at a later point if/when there is demand.

There's also some further work I want to do on the leaderboard itself (positional updates should be debounced differently to prioritise immediate response if the leaderboard hasn't updated recently, for example) but I'll make those changes separately.

Closes #18879.

- [ ] Depends on #20389 (for test to show up properly).

issue_context.title: Add in-game leaderboard display
issue_context.body:
We have a pretty nice leaderboard display in multiplayer, but it's currently missing in both solo and playlist modes.

The leaderboard implementation will likely need some server-side considerations, as we want to (hopefully) display more than the top 50 players this time around.

A good starting point would get the leaderboard working with local scores. Online scores can be added as a subsequent step.

review_comments: The old bindables probably need to be unbound.

When finishing gameplay, the user's submitted online score seems to be added to the `Scores` list, which makes it appear on the leaderboard:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22781491/191360700-d526ed6b-148c-4089-bd09-d3efbd4114d9.mp4

I think that could be fixed by checking against the score ID, similar to how it's done on results screens.

This is a bit unfortunate, as it was avoided by having the schedule in place previously.

I've fixed this by unbinding the scores, rather than trying any kind of ID matching (sounds awkward).
This doesn't seem to reset when selecting another beatmap while on "Details" section, causing the gameplay session to show a leaderboard with scores from another beatmap.

I've fixed this by clearing the old scores for now.

I think in the future we'd either want the leaderboard to be always present at song select (ie. with the new design), or the retrieval should be done by its own component (as @smoogipoo touched on earlier).
